details:
Q1
What is the narrowest primary target for this issue?
Choices:
A. One specific workflow, script, or file path that you name explicitly (RECOMMENDED)
B. Clarify / plan phase behavior
C. Implement / review_autofix / validate behavior
D. Orchestrator / poller / issue/PR state automation
E. Documentation / README / runbook content only
Q2
What kind of improvement do you want in that target?
Choices:
A. Fix a broken behavior or failure — include the current behavior and the expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Reduce noise, duplication, or unnecessary churn — say what should happen less often
C. Improve speed, cost, or rate-limit behavior — say what is currently too slow or too expensive
D. Improve clarity of docs or operator guidance — say what is missing or misleading
Q3
What concrete reference should planning use as the success check?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow run, issue/PR example, log snippet, or failing scenario (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific acceptance criterion in plain language describing what should be true when this is done
C. A specific file/script/function plus the exact behavior that should change
